name: Vice Chancellor Alendis
description: A former Academy man who told Daretti the Academy was not ready for a goblin and has apparently joined the Custodi; he is next on Daretti's list.

timeline.summary: The Board of Senior Advisors rejects Muzzio's motion to become vice chancellor after Alendis retires and elects Tulando instead.
timeline.quote: To elect Professor Tulando vice chancellor once Alendis retires.

timeline.summary: With the others gone, the board carries Muzzio's motion to become vice chancellor once Alendis becomes chancellor.
Daretti names Alendis, who apparently joined the Custodi, as his next target; Grenzo adds anyone in league with Marchesa.
timeline.quote: Sounds like the oily bastard joined the Custodi.

pages_say.description: The vice chancellor of the Academy who is soon to retire.
